# Fork contributor instructions

Follow AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. MCP worker routing is limited to pi/pi-balanced/max. MCP orchestration defaults OFF; Pi AUTO/ON/OFF is a separate preference. Codex native subagents remain independent under Codex and project rules. Preserve the upstream license and notices. Keep credentials and local configuration outside the repository. Never publish, push, or create a release without explicit owner authorization.
